37782-life-in-an-indian-outpost.creator: Unknown

arxiv-2103-01576.title: FinMatcher at FinSim-2: Hypernym Detection in the Financial Services Domain using Knowledge Graphs Conference: Companion Proceedings of the Web Conference 2021; April 19–23, 2021; Ljubljana, Slovenia Companion Proceedings of the Web Conference 2021 (WWW ’21 Companion), April 19–23, 2021, Ljubljana,
arxiv-2103-01576.creator: Jan Portisch, Michael Hladik, Heiko Paulheim
arxiv-2103-01576.description: Abstract . This paper presents the FinMatcher system and its results for the FinSim 2021 shared task which is co-located with the Workshop on Financial Technology on the Web (FinWeb) in conjunction with The Web Conference. The FinSim-2 shared task consists of a set of concept labels from the financial services domain.

arxiv-2110-14736.title: Effects of a Quantum or Classical Scalar Field on the Entanglement Entropy of a Pair of Universes
arxiv-2110-14736.creator: Samuel Barroso Bellido
arxiv-2110-14736.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Samuel Barroso Bellido. Using the formalism of the third quantization in canonical quantum gravity, the entropy of entanglement of a pair of universes created in the multiverse from the vacuum has lately been calculated. Here, we examine the differences between considering a scalar field as quantum or classical on the entanglement entropy of three different pairs: de-Sitter universes, flat stiff matter dominated universes, and closed universes with a scalar field.

arxiv-2204-11054.title: MLP-Hash: Protecting Face Templates via Hashing of Randomized Multi-Layer Perceptron Thanks: This research is based upon work supported by the H2020 TReSPAsS-ETN Marie Skłodowska-Curie early training network (grant agreement 860813).
arxiv-2204-11054.creator: Hatef Otroshi Shahreza 1,2 , Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn 1 , and Sébastien Marcel 1,3
arxiv-2204-11054.description: Abstract Applications of face recognition systems for authentication purposes are growing rapidly. Although state-of-the-art (SOTA) face recognition systems have high recognition accuracy, the features which are extracted for each user and are stored in the system’s database contain privacy-sensitive information. Accordingly, compromising this data would jeopardize users’ privacy.

arxiv-2308-14650.title: Comparison of automated crater catalogs for Mars from Benedix et al. (2020) and Lee & Hogan (2021)
arxiv-2308-14650.description: Abstract Crater mapping using neural networks and other automated methods has increased recently with automated Crater Detection Algorithms (CDAs) applied to planetary bodies throughout the solar system. A recent publication by Benedix et al. (2020) showed high performance at small scales compared to similar automated CDAs but with a net positive diameter bias in many crater candidates.

arxiv-2311-01926.title: On Schreier-type Sets, Partitions, and Compositions
arxiv-2311-01926.creator: Kevin Beanland, Hùng Việt Chu
arxiv-2311-01926.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kevin Beanland, Hùng Việt Chu. A nonempty set A ⊂ ℕ A\subset\mathbb{N} is ℓ \ell -strong Schreier if min ⁡ A ⩾ ℓ ​ | A | − ℓ + 1 \min A\geqslant\ell|A|-\ell+1 . We define a set of positive integers to be sparse if either the set has at most two numbers or the differences between consecutive numbers in increasing order are non-decreasing. This note establishes a connection between sparse Schreier-type sets and (restricted) partition numbers.

arxiv-2311-12056.title: Kuro Siwo: 33 billion m 2 m^{2} under the water A global multi-temporal satellite dataset for rapid flood mapping
arxiv-2311-12056.creator: Nikolaos Ioannis Bountos bountos@noa.gr, Maria Sdraka masdra@noa.gr, Angelos Zavras azabras@noa.gr, Ilektra Karasante ile.karasante@noa.gr, Andreas Karavias karavias@hua.gr, Themistocles Herekakis therekak@noa.gr, Angeliki Thanasou thanasoua@gmail.com, Dimitrios Michail michail@hua.gr, Ioannis Papou
arxiv-2311-12056.description: Abstract Global flash floods, exacerbated by climate change, pose severe threats to human life, infrastructure, and the environment. Recent catastrophic events in Pakistan and New Zealand underscore the urgent need for precise flood mapping to guide restoration efforts, understand vulnerabilities, and prepare for future occurrences.

arxiv-2311-18362.title: Curvature directed anchoring and defect structure of colloidal smectic liquid crystals in confinement
arxiv-2311-18362.creator: Ethan I. L. Jull, Gerardo Campos-Villalobos, Qianjing Tang, Marjolein Dijkstra, Lisa Tran
arxiv-2311-18362.description: Abstract Rod-like objects at high packing fractions can form smectic phases, where the rods break rotational and translational symmetry by forming lamellae. Smectic defects thereby include both discontinuities in the rod orientational order (disclinations), as well as in the positional order (dislocations).

arxiv-2404-16844.title: Sugarcane Health Monitoring With Satellite Spectroscopy and Machine Learning: A Review
arxiv-2404-16844.creator: Ethan Kane Waters, Carla Chia-ming Chen, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi
arxiv-2404-16844.description: Abstract A B S T R A C T Research into large-scale crop monitoring has flourished due to increased accessibility to satellite imagery. This review delves into previously unexplored and under-explored areas in sugarcane health monitoring and disease/pest detection using satellite-based spectroscopy and Machine Learning (ML).

arxiv-2407-01296.title: Non-Hermitian skin effect in arbitrary dimensions: non-Bloch band theory and classification
arxiv-2407-01296.creator: Yuncheng Xiong 1, Ze-Yu Xing 1,2, Haiping Hu 1, 2
arxiv-2407-01296.description: Abstract Non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) is a distinctive phenomenon in non-Hermitian systems, characterized by a significant accumulation of eigenstates at system boundaries. While well-understood in one dimension via non-Bloch band theory, unraveling the NHSE in higher dimensions faces formidable challenges due to the diversity of open boundary conditions or lattice geometries and inevitable numerical errors.

arxiv-2411-17931.title: Combining Threat Intelligence with IoT Scanning to Predict Cyber Attacks
arxiv-2411-17931.creator: Jubin Abhishek Soni, Amit Anand, Rajesh Kumar Pandey, Aniket Abhishek Soni
arxiv-2411-17931.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jubin Abhishek Soni, Amit Anand, Rajesh Kumar Pandey, Aniket Abhishek Soni. While the Web has become a global platform for communication; malicious actors, including hackers and hacktivist groups, often disseminate ideological content and coordinate activities through the ”Dark Web”—an obscure counterpart of the conventional web. Presently, challenges such as information overload and the fragmented nature of cyber threat data impede comprehensive profiling of these actors, thereby limiting the efficacy of predictive analyses of their online activities.

arxiv-2503-10383.title: Position Reconstruction in the DEAP-3600 Dark Matter Search Experiment
arxiv-2503-10383.creator: A. Zuñiga-Reyes
arxiv-2503-10383.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. Zuñiga-Reyes. In the DEAP-3600 dark matter search experiment, precise reconstruction of the positions of scattering events in liquid argon is key for background rejection and defining a fiducial volume that enhances dark matter candidate events identification. This paper describes three distinct position reconstruction algorithms employed by DEAP-3600, leveraging the spatial and temporal information provided by photomultipliers surrounding a spherical liquid argon vessel.

arxiv-2510-27338.title: Reasoning Models Sometimes Output Illegible Chains of Thought
arxiv-2510-27338.creator: Arun Jose
arxiv-2510-27338.description: Abstract Language models trained via outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) to reason using chain-of-thought (CoT) have shown remarkable performance. Monitoring such a model’s CoT may allow us to understand its intentions and detect potential malicious behavior. However, to be effective, this requires that CoTs are legible and faithful.

britannica-1911-southey-robert.title: Southey, Robert (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-southey-robert.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-southey-robert.description: Article 'Southey, Robert' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. At Oxford he lived a life apart, and gained little or nothing from the university, except a liking for swimming and a knowledge of Epictetus. In the vacation of 1793 Southey's enthusiasm for the French Revolution found vent in the writing of an epic poem, Joan of Arc, published in 1796 by Joseph Cottle, the Bristol bookseller.

pmc-10548871.title: Long-Term Exposure to Walkable Residential Neighborhoods and Risk of Obesity-Related Cancer in the New York University Women’s Health Study (NYUWHS)
pmc-10548871.creator: Sandra India-Aldana, Andrew G. Rundle, James W. Quinn, Tess V. Clendenen, Yelena Afanasyeva, Karen L. Koenig, Mengling Liu, Kathryn M. Neckerman, Lorna E. Thorpe, Anne Zeleniuch-Jacquotte, Yu Chen
pmc-10548871.description: Background:Living in neighborhoods with higher levels of walkability has been associated with a reduced risk of obesity and higher levels of physical activity. Obesity has been linked to increased risk of 13 cancers in women. However, long-term prospective studies of neighborhood walkability and risk for obesity-related cancer are scarce.

pmc-10574340.title: Implementation of Nutritional Assessment and Counseling in Physical Therapy Treatment: An Anonymous Cross-Sectional Survey
pmc-10574340.creator: Roy Netzer, Michal Elboim-Gabyzon, Francisco José Amaro-Gahete
pmc-10574340.description: In the context of the evolving role of Physical Therapists (PTs) in health promotion, this study explored the incorporation of nutritional assessment and counseling into PTs’ professional practice in Israel. Using an anonymous cross-sectional survey design, the research gauged PTs’ professional background, nutritional knowledge, lifestyle habits, and the extent of nutritional care integration.

pmc-10593862.title: Effects of different mulch materials on the photosynthetic characteristics, yield, and soil water use efficiency of wheat in Loess tableland
pmc-10593862.creator: Shenglan Ye, Juan Li, Hui Kong, Jianglong Shen, Dan Wu
pmc-10593862.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Due to the lack of precipitation and poor temporal and spatial stability in the Loess Plateau for a long time, it is necessary to adopt mulching technology to support the stable and high yield of wheat cultivation system. This study aims at exploring different mulching materials on the soil water content, photosynthetic characteristics, wheat yield, and yield components of winter wheat in the gully region of the Loess Plateau.

pmc-11358983.title: Evaluation of THP-1 and Jurkat Cell Lines Coculture for the In Vitro Assessment of the Effects of Immunosuppressive Substances
pmc-11358983.creator: Nina Franko, Marija Sollner Dolenc, Natalia Garcia-Reyero
pmc-11358983.description: The strong appeal to reduce animal testing calls for the development and validation of in vitro, in chemico and in silico models that would replace the need for in vivo testing and ex vivo materials. A category that requires such new approach methods is the assessment of immunosuppression that can be induced by chemicals including environmental pollutants.

pmc-11509459.title: Isolation of Virulent Leptospira Serogroup Australis Field Strains from Symptomatic Dogs for Canine Leptospiral Vaccine Development
pmc-11509459.creator: Pierre Bergamo, Marine Le Guyader, Marine Hugonnard, Pascale Bourhy, Nathalie Simon-Dufay, Jérôme Bouvet, Jean-Christophe Thibault, Lionel Cupillard, Paweł Stefanoff
pmc-11509459.description: Leptospirosis is a widespread zoonosis caused by spirochaetes belonging to the pathogenic species of Leptospira, which are classified into more than 25 serogroups and 250 serovars. Vaccination can prevent the disease in dogs but offers incomplete efficacy because of a lack of cross-protection between serogroups.

pmc-11673060.title: Student Violence Against Paraprofessionals in Schools: A Social-Ecological Analysis of Safety and Well-Being
pmc-11673060.creator: Linda A Reddy, Andrew H Perry, Andrew Martinez, Susan D McMahon, Kailyn Bare, Taylor Swenski, Christopher M Dudek, Eric M Anderman, Ron Avi Astor, Dorothy L Espelage, Frank C Worrell, Heng Choon Oliver Chan
pmc-11673060.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Violence against teachers has received increasing attention worldwide, with high rates of verbal, threatening, physical, and property violence in schools. Teacher-directed violence contributes to poor mental and physical health, high rates of turnover, and diminished student achievement. Despite these findings, there is a dearth of research on violence experienced by paraprofessionals who play key roles in supporting students with the greatest learning and behavioral needs in schools.

pmc-11674414.title: Gasdermin D (GSDM D) as a Potential Diagnostic Biomarker in Bladder Cancer: New Perspectives in Detection
pmc-11674414.creator: Monika Gudowska-Sawczuk, Sara Pączek, Michał Olkowicz, Jacek Kudelski, Barbara Mroczko, Ke Chen
pmc-11674414.description: Simple SummaryBladder cancer is a significant healthcare problem due to its increasing incidence and high morbidity and mortality rates. It affects a large number of people globally, and its management poses both clinical and economic challenges. Some studies have suggested that the expression of gasdermin D in bladder cancer cells could be associated with the progression of the disease.

pmc-12418017.title: Impact of comprehensive psychological cognitive nursing on the quality of life of patients with chronic pain and depression
pmc-12418017.creator: Yan Cheng, Jv-Ming Mao, Ying Zhang
pmc-12418017.description: BACKGROUNDChronic pain and depression often coexist, severely affecting quality of life. Traditional treatments address these conditions separately, but comprehensive psychological cognitive nursing offers a holistic approach. By combining cognitive-behavioral strategies and psychological support, it helps improve coping mechanisms, reduce distress, and enhance overall well-being in affected patients.

pmc-12749252.description: The WEE1 kinase negatively regulates CDK1/2 to control DNA replication and mitotic entry. Genetic factors that determine sensitivity to WEE1 inhibitors (WEE1i) are largely unknown. A genome-wide insertional mutagenesis screen revealed that mutation of EIF2A, a translation regulator, sensitized to WEE1i.

pmc-13331034.title: Laparoscopic and Open Repair of an Intercostal Abdominal Hernia
pmc-13331034.creator: Erick R Guerra Bocanegra, Ana P Rábago Jamaica, Hector M Alcaraz Amaya, Farah M Hadad Monsiváis
pmc-13331034.description: Intercostal hernias are uncommon defects of the thoracoabdominal wall.We present the case of a 53-year-old male patient with progressive bulging of the left lateral abdominal wall. Computed tomography (CT) with the Valsalva maneuver demonstrated disruption of the left external oblique muscle and muscular asymmetry consistent with a hernia defect.

pmc-13572644.title: Commentary on structural inequities in global health research funding and practice
pmc-13572644.creator: Saralees Nadarajah, Samuel Manda, Queensley C. Chukwudum
pmc-13572644.description: The testimonies gathered from researchers across Africa present a damning portrait of persistent structural inequities in how international research partnerships are conceived, funded, and executed. These firsthand accounts, spanning multiple countries and decades of experience, reveal patterns of exploitation, marginalization, and systemic bias that undermine both the integrity of scientific inquiry and the dignity of African researchers.
